What the three parts are
Decision time on the device: the window must
contain the keyword end, then 3 consecutive scores
(60 ms apart) must average ≥ 0.80. Deliberate:
it is the false-trigger defence. Median 111 ms,
p95 171 ms; located at 20 ms resolution.
Capture term, NOT measured: last sample in the
ring → decision (≤ 10 ms DMA hop + ≈ 2–3 ms
processing; mic group delay 1.08 ms). Taken as
10 ± 7 ms. A GPIO + logic-analyser rig (IN-1/IN-2)
would measure it; it was not available.
Transport: detection → first audio packet read by
the server (device and server clocks aligned by
ping, ± 1.2–1.8 ms). START message 2.4 ms; audio
18 ms median with Vosk running (2.1 ms without
ASR load on 27 Sep, E-37).
Other measurements of the same quantity: 95 ms median / 136 ms p95 (27 Sep, capture build, no ASR load, n = 22, E-37); 81 / 172 ms (29 Sep, with ASR, keyword + command, n = 9, E-62).
Architecture estimate before any build: ≈ 205 ms typical (Track C §10.3, smoothing window 5 at 30 ms cadence). Sources: evidence/server/20260930_085548/latency_report.json.
